confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief to confirm whether LH-02 is actually stopped. Radio and CMMS disagree. Move nothing for this place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09 (radio and CMMS agree). The stope has 256 t at 16.5 g/t, about 135 oz, and the repair is likely around 13:30. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 10:00, has no home production to lose, and is 0.33 h from the stope. It would load about 30 t/h from 10:20, roughly 190 t, or about 100 oz of high-grade ore. Central is truck-limited (91 t/h against 110 t/h inflow), so the gain is mainly high-grade ore replacing lower-grade ore in the haul, not extra tonnes. I discounted the estimate for that. I did not take a loader from a producing stope or a heading. Moving LH-08 would cost 0.4 oz per hour and the gain would be marginal. The LH-02 conflict is a rule-based hold, so nothing moves there and I ask the area chief to confirm.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
